chain.title: An Edge Before Iron
chain.desc: Bone and a stick. Delightful's cheapest knife, and the reason you can use a cutting board on day one instead of waiting for iron.

chain.title: Knifing An Oak
chain.desc: Acorns come from cutting oak leaves and from acorn blocks, both through data/delightful/loot_modifiers/. A food source hiding in the tree you already chopped down.

chain.title: Roasted Until Edible
chain.desc: Raw acorns are poor food; roasted they feed properly. The sack packs nine for storage.

chain.title: Flour From Nuts
chain.desc: Ground acorns worked into dough. It is a parallel dough to Farmer's Delight's wheat dough and the base of the baklava.

chain.title: Berries On The Riverbank
chain.desc: Wild salmonberry bushes generate in the world. They are Delightful's own berry, distinct from vanilla sweet berries and glow berries.

chain.title: Seeds From The Bush
chain.desc: Pips replant salmonberries. Delightful's berry line is the only fully self-contained crop chain in the mod.

chain.title: A Basket Of Salmonberries
chain.desc: Harvested from a grown bush. They feed the pie, the gummy, the ice cream and the milkshake.

chain.title: Melon, But Not That Melon
chain.desc: Cantaloupe is Delightful's own melon, with its own seeds, slices and a stuffed feast block. It grows on farmland like any vine crop.

chain.title: The Whole Fruit
chain.desc: Grown from seed. Knifing it gives slices, and the slices give seeds back, so the loop closes.

chain.title: Sliced
chain.desc: Knife a cantaloupe. Slices are what the bread, the popsicle and the gummy consume.

chain.title: Wrapped For The Road
chain.desc: Cantaloupe bundled for travel. It stacks where the whole fruit does not.

chain.title: Leaves Worth Grinding
chain.desc: Green tea leaves come from a loot modifier rather than a crop. They are the only ingredient in matcha.

chain.title: Ground To Powder
chain.desc: Green tea leaves milled down. Matcha branches into a latte, a gummy, an ice cream and a milkshake, which is more use than most mods get from one leaf.

chain.title: Rendering The Kill
chain.desc: Animal fat is what Delightful pulls off ordinary livestock that Farmer's Delight leaves on the bone.

chain.title: Bottled Fat
chain.desc: Rendered animal fat in a bottle. It is a fuel as well as an ingredient.

chain.title: Chevon
chain.desc: Goats drop meat through data/delightful/loot_modifiers/raw_goat.json. Vanilla goats drop nothing at all; Delightful gives them a purpose.

chain.title: Chevon, Cooked
chain.desc: Also supplied directly by a loot modifier when the goat dies burning, as well as by cooking the raw cut.

chain.title: Chops From The Deer
chain.desc: Delightful's venison line hooks whichever deer mob your pack ships and turns it into chops and stew.

chain.title: Cutting Into A Cactus
chain.desc: Knife a cactus and it yields chunks plus green dye. Desert survival food, and the base of the chili and the soup.

chain.title: Cactus, Seared
chain.desc: Cactus flesh cooked. It is the only meat-equivalent a player can make without killing anything.

chain.title: Roe In A Bottle
chain.desc: Caviar is bottled fish roe, and one of the few genuinely luxury foods in the Farmer's Delight ecosystem.

chain.title: Toasted Between Biscuits
chain.desc: The marshmallow line ends here. It is the mod's most-requested recipe and its least serious.

chain.title: Layered With Nuts And Honey
chain.desc: Nut dough, honey and sugar. The completion bake of the acorn line and the only pastry here that slices.

chain.title: Sour Soup
chain.desc: Sinigang is Delightful's most ambitious Cooking Pot dish and the only one named after a real regional recipe rather than a Minecraft pun.

notes: 178 ids resolve as assets/delightful/models/item/<id>.json intersected with item./block. lang keys, but that number is MISLEADING and a quest generator must not treat it as 178 questable items. Delightful is primarily a COMPATIBILITY mod: 69 of those ids are knives, one per material from a different mod, and every knife recipe in data/delightful/recipes/integration/ is wrapped in forge:conditional with both a forge:mod_loaded gate and a delightful:enabled config gate. The item is registered either way, so an FTBQ item task on delightful:zanite_knife will never complete without the Aether installed. Every recipe was scanned for its forge:mod_loaded conditions before anything entered this chain. The only knives with NO mod gate at all are bone, copper, emerald, lapis_lazuli and the forge-tag metals (aluminum, brass, bronze, constantan, invar, lead, nickel, steel, tin, zinc); delightful:bone_knife is the one used here because it needs nothing but vanilla. Knives gated on mods elsewhere in this research set, for a pack that ships them: alf_knife (mythicbotany), manasteel_knife / elementium_knife / terra_knife (botania), fiery_knife and knightmetal_knife (twilightforest + twilightdelight). Everything in the chain and the three wheels was individually checked to have needs=[] - no third mod required - with two documented exceptions kept on purpose because this research set also ships them: matcha_latte and azalea_tea/lavender_tea require farmersrespite. Mob and block drops verified in data/delightful/loot_modifiers/: green_tea_leaf, raw_goat, cooked_goat, acorn_from_knife, acorn_block and straw. EXCLUDED for third-mod gates: jam_jar and glow_jam_jar (brewinandchewin + fruitsdelight + hearthandharvest), marshmallow_stick (hearthandharvest), the roe_blini/roe_roll line (letfishlove), nut_butter_bottle (vintagedelight), rock_candy (dungeonsdelight), the *_ice_cream_block variants (neapolitan), the glow_jam cookie tile slab/stairs/wall set (cookielicious). Parent items this addon assumes you already have: farmersdelight:cutting_board, farmersdelight:cooking_pot, farmersdelight:pie_crust, farmersdelight:tomato_sauce, farmersdelight:onion and tomato crops, farmersdelight:rice, for the tea branch: farmersrespite:kettle.
